text: きみの　ポケモンは　どこで　とって　きたのかな？

structure.jp: きみの　ポケモンは
とって　きたのかな？
structure.en: did you catch them, I wonder

patterns.name: 〜のかな
patterns.explanation: のかな at the end shows the speaker is wondering about something. とって　きたのかな = 'I wonder where you caught them'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる means doing something and then coming back. とって　きた = 'caught them and came back with them'.
